prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: ONE production animation sprite atlas for IQX's Bạch Hổ (white tiger) companion, all frames of the SAME character.
Input image: style and species reference only, use the WHITE TIGER on the FAR LEFT. Do NOT include the other species or background.
Canvas: 3840 x 3200 PNG with actual transparent alpha. EXACTLY six equal columns by five equal rows, each cell 640 x 640, no gaps, no borders, no labels. Each of the 30 cells contains one complete full-body white tiger at the same scale/camera/foot baseline, centered. Character is 75% of cell height; all ears/tail/feet fit inside 8% padding.
Style: crisp clean 2D chibi game pet, dark navy rounded outlines, two soft cel-shaded layers. NOT 3D, no realistic fur. White coat, small royal-blue tiger stripes, blue ear tips, blue-tipped curled tiger tail, blue eyes, blue forehead diamond, deep-blue scarf with small white IQX letters, blue crystal pendant. Head 45% of height. Warm confident gentle face, front view slightly 3/4.
Animation by ROW, left to right:
ROW 1 idle: neutral both eyes open; tiny breath rise; eyelids half closed; both eyes closed blink; eyes reopening; neutral again.
ROW 2 greet: neutral; right forepaw starts lifting; right forepaw lifted greeting; paw lifted and wink smile; paw lowering; neutral again.
ROW 3 analyzing: calm focused eyes; ears attentive; forepaw points slightly toward invisible data; glance slightly right; tiny focused nod; return focused pose. No props.
ROW 4 updated: notice; small nod; confident nod down; blue crystal slightly brighter; neutral; duplicate neutral.
ROW 5 tap: neutral; one ear twitches and eyes widen a little; head tilts slightly with playful wink; neutral; duplicate neutral; duplicate neutral.
Across ALL cells, lock character identity, proportions, scarf and crystal positions, palette, outline width, camera and baseline. Only listed facial/limb microposes change. No jump, no motion blur. Keep the center of mass aligned within 2%. No ground shadow, platform, stage glow, background, charts, decorative objects, money, confetti, weapons, captions, watermarks. This is one tightly registered sprite atlas, not a poster or contact sheet with uneven spacing.
